aggregation: Median of three independent trial statistics, not pooled latency percentiles; min/max and sample CV retained. No failed/short trials discarded.
limitations: Apple M4 macOS developer workstation, battery power and Low Power Mode enabled; user applications left running.
Loopback client and server share CPU and memory; native thread-count sensitivity is material. These are not isolated server capacity ceilings.
GET/HGET data is populated; SET/HSET vary payload suffixes and ZADD varies scores; workloads are isolated operations, not an 80/20 mixed traffic trace.
Native pipelined latency is first-read-event latency reused across replies, not batch-completion or per-command end-to-end latency; histogram clamps at3s.
Main native durations range from 2.006s to5.026s; three trials missed the80%-of3s target and remain included. All222 native measured trials lasted at least1s.
Durable modes compare acknowledged-write policies, not equal fsync counts, checkpoint costs, recovery or power-loss guarantees; automatic checkpoints/AOF rewrites disabled.
Strict-write variability is high in some profiles (up to30.3% sample CV); report medians and ranges, not fine-grained superiority claims.
List-backlog throughput uses Python-threaded client and is not native capacity evidence; RSS is current process residency, not peak or logical data size.
Four ffkv shards and memory backend; hybrid beyond-RAM storage, replication, clustering, TLS and eviction not measured.
